newsitem.title: USA: Verilink sees Q3 earnings below forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Verilink sees Q3 earnings below forecasts.

text.p: Verilink Corp on Wednesday said it expected to report third-quarter earnings of between $0.05 and $0.07 per share, which falls short of the First Call consensus forecast of $0.13.
The company also said it expected third-quarter sales of $13.5 million to $14.5 million.
In the year-earlier quarter, Verilink reported sales of $10.5 million and earnings of $0.07 per share, excluding a $0.03 tax benefit.
Verilink said it revised its forecast downward because sales were hurt by a slowdown in the rate of equipment deployment by its main customers.
It expects sales to its five largest customers to make up 55 percent to 60 percent of total sales in the latest third quarter, compared with 72 percent in the year-ago period.
Verilink provides integrated access products for telecommunications network service providers and corporate end-users.
